plugin.name: Catgirl Mail
plugin.description: Let the catgirl handle your mail. Supports any SMTP / IMAP / POP3 mailbox, multiple accounts, auto-check with a meow notification, and send-on-your-behalf.
add_account.name: Add mail account
add_account.description: Configure a mailbox account (IMAP/POP3 receive + SMTP send) so the catgirl can send/receive mail for you.
list_accounts.name: List mail accounts
list_accounts.description: List all configured mail accounts (passwords hidden).
remove_account.name: Remove mail account
send_mail.name: Send mail
send_mail.description: Send an email from a chosen account; the catgirl delivers it for you.
check_mail.name: Check mail
check_mail.description: Immediately check for new mail (IMAP unseen / POP3 recent).
read_mail.name: Read mail
read_mail.description: Read the full content of a specific email.
inbox_summary.name: Inbox summary
inbox_summary.description: Summarize unread mail across all accounts.
auto_check.name: Auto check
auto_check.description: Periodically check for new mail and meow a notification to the owner.
